newsitem.title: USA: Duriron sees Q2 earnings above Q1.
newsitem.headline: Duriron sees Q2 earnings above Q1.

text.p: Duriron Co Inc said Thursday it expects substantially stronger performance in the second quarter, after reporting first quarter earnings of $0.47 a share on sales of 147.8 million.
"We are poised for a stronger second quarter with improved performance expected in shipments, earnings and incoming business," the company said in a statement.

"With greater sales volume, gross margin at target and minimal projected increase in selling, general and administrative expenses, we anticipate a meaningful earnings improvement over the first quarter of 1997 and second quarter of 1996."
The company had previously been named Durco International Inc.
